title: Lake Louise and Moraine Lake Express from Banff
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the stunning landscapes of Lake Louise and Moraine Lake with this convenient 1.5 hour shuttle tour. Departing from the Mount Royal Hotel and Banff Train Station, this service allows you to soak in the majestic beauty of turquoise waters surrounded by towering peaks. Enjoy a hassle-free experience whether you're starting or wrapping up your day in Banff. Perfect for families, adventurers, and nature lovers alike, this tour connects you to two of Canada’s most iconic natural gems in a swift, scenic journey.
